title.zh: 化学平衡 · 人数不变，人还在跑
title.en: Chemical Equilibrium · Still Moving at Balance

desc.zh: 平衡不是反应停了，而是正、逆两个方向跑得一样快：计数走平，粒子还在互变。加一把料、升一次温，看平衡点如何移动；再验证催化剂只改快慢、不改终点。
desc.en: Equilibrium is not the reaction stopping — it is both directions running equally fast: counts level off while particles keep swapping. Add material, raise the temperature and watch the balance point shift; then check that a catalyst changes only the speed, never the endpoint.
